A region in the $x$-$y$ plane is bounded by the curve $y=\operatorname{sin}⁡x+\frac{1}{x}$, the $x$-axis and the lines $x=1$ and $x=\pi $, as shown above. The area of the region is
worked_solution:
To find the area, we just need to compute the corresponding definite integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ={\int }_{a}^{b}y(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\pi }(\operatorname{sin}⁡x+\frac{1}{x})\,\text{d}x \\  & =(-\operatorname{cos}⁡x+\operatorname{ln}⁡x){|}_{1}^{\pi } \\  & =(-\operatorname{cos}⁡\pi +\operatorname{ln}⁡\pi )-(-\operatorname{cos}⁡1+\operatorname{ln}⁡1) \\  & =1+\operatorname{ln}⁡\pi +\operatorname{cos}⁡1.\end{aligned}
$$
